item.title: Environmentalist group announces free community classes
item.description: Monthly classes and environmentalist experiences are now available through nonprofit Friends of Grand Rapids Parks' brand-new Neighborhood Conservationist program — and it's all free.

item.description: The Hall of Famer died in Orlando, his family announced on Wednesday.

item.title: Downtown Kalamazoo parking rates to change in April
item.description: Starting in April, there will be parking changes across downtown Kalamazoo. Some areas will be converted to paid parking, others will be converted from paid to free parking.

item.title: West Michigan woman increasingly worried for family stuck in Dubai

item.title: Grand Rapids named 'Beer City, USA' for sixth year in a row
item.description: Grand Rapids has earned the title Beer City, USA for the sixth year in a row, according to USA Today.

item.title: New weapon detection system aims to prevent violence against U-M Health-West workers
item.description: Security is getting tighter at the emergency department at University of Michigan Health-West, with the Wyoming hospital saying it's working to combat a trend of verbal and physical aggression against health care workers.
